title: Leadership Check-in One-Pager + Client Quarterly Digest Template
body:
Purpose:
A concise one-page summary for leadership check-ins plus a customer-facing quarterly digest email template. Designed for CSMs to surface impact, risks, and asks to executive sponsors and product/engineering partners, while also providing a polished, customer-facing recap for procurement and leadership stakeholders.

How to use this artifact:
- Fill the one-pager fields before the leadership call (max 1 page / 5–7 minutes to present).
- Send the customer-facing digest within 48 hours after the QBR or leadership check-in.
- Use the Renewal Pulse section to triage next actions and escalate to AE/AM if risk_score >= 6.

Part A — Leadership Check-in One-Pager (internal, 1 page max)
[Header]
Customer: {{CUSTOMER_NAME}}
Customer Tier: {{TIER}} (e.g., Strategic / Growth / SMB)
Primary Sponsor: {{SPONSOR_NAME}} — Title: {{SPONSOR_TITLE}}
CSM: {{CSM_NAME}} | Last touch: {{LAST_TOUCH_DATE}} | Days since onboarding: {{DAYS_SINCE_ONBOARD}}

[Key outcomes this quarter — 3 bullets]
1) Business impact: "Deployed Redwood-hosted API for {product-feature}, reduced inference latency by ~{X}% and average cost-per-1k tokens down {Y}% (sample metric below)."
2) Adoption highlight: {team/feature} has {N} active integrations and {M} monthly calls.
3) Success story / customer quote: "{short quote}"

[Top metrics — single-line table style]
- Production throughput: {tokens/sec} | P95 latency: {p95_ms}ms | Monthly token volume: {tokens_month} | Cost per 1k: ${cost_per_1k}
- Error rate (request failures): {error_rate}% | SLA compliance: {sla_pct}%

[Health + Renewal Pulse — 1–10 scoring]
- Usage health: {1-10} (trend: up / flat / down)
- Technical health: {1-10} (deploy reliability, error rate)
- Business alignment: {1-10} (product roadmap fit, exec sponsorship)
- Renewal Risk Score: {aggregate 1-10}
Guidance: 1–3 = green; 4–6 = watch; 7–10 = high risk. If Renewal Risk Score >= 6, escalate to AM and schedule an executive-to-executive conversation within 7 business days.

[Top 3 Risks & Mitigations — quick bullets]
1) Risk: {e.g., latency spikes on peak} — Mitigation: Enable autoscaling burst + route to lower-quantized model variant. Owner: infra/CSM.
2) Risk: {feature parity gap vs competitor} — Mitigation: Product roadmap alignment + demo of workaround. Owner: Product.
3) Risk: {cost concerns} — Mitigation: Redwood Optimize recommendations + 2-week trial of caching policy. Owner: CSM + Solutions Eng.

[Asks from leadership / decisions needed]
- Decide on 12-month commit level for Dedicated offering by {decision_date}.
- Approval to fund a swift POC for on-prem connector (estimated engineering 2 wks).

[Immediate next actions (owner + due date)]
- Schedule 30-min follow-up with Sponsor & AE — Owner: CSM — Due: {date}
- Deploy prefix cache for high-volume routes — Owner: Solutions Eng — Due: {date}
- Prepare 1-page ROI for procurement — Owner: AE — Due: {date}

Part B — Customer-Facing Quarterly Digest Email (send within 48 hrs)
Subject suggestions (pick one):
- "Quarterly recap: {{CUSTOMER_NAME}} + Redwood — Highlights & next steps"
- "Q{Q} recap: Performance, wins, and asks from Redwood"
Preheader (one-liner): "Short summary: performance, adoption, recommended actions."
Recipient list (suggested):
- Primary sponsor, VP-level stakeholders, procurement lead, product lead, engineering manager, AE/AM, CSM (bcc optional).

Email body (personalize with 4–6 short sections):
Hi {{SPONSOR_FIRST_NAME}},

Thanks for taking time for our recent check-in. Below is a short recap and the actions we agreed to. Please let me know if you'd like anything added to the next discussion.

1) Quick wins & impact
- Latency improved: P95 down to {p95_ms}ms (benchmark vs last quarter: {prev_p95_ms}ms).
- Cost efficiency: estimated savings ~${savings} monthly after enabling caching.
- Adoption: {N} active routes; {M} new internal users.

2) What we delivered this quarter
- {Feature/Integration} rolled out to production on {date}.
- Documentation & runbook handed off to {team}.

3) Where we saw friction
- Short summary of top issues (one short paragraph).

4) Proposed next steps (clear owners + dates)
- {Action 1} — Owner: {owner} — Due: {date}
- {Action 2} — Owner: {owner} — Due: {date}

5) Renewal & contract health (optional short paragraph)
- Current term ends: {renewal_date}. Renewal health: {green/amber/red}. Recommended next meeting: {date}.

Closing (call to action)
Would you be available for a 20-min alignment on {proposed_date}? We can walk the ROI slide and outline a proposed commit level.

Thanks,
{CSM_NAME} | Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

Appendix (paste into the email or attach):
- 1-page one-pager (internal) — PDF attached for leadership.
- Simple renewal tracker snapshot (paste below or attach as CSV).

Renewal Tracker snapshot (CSV-friendly lines):
customer,renewal_date,current_term_value,renewal_probability(%),renewal_health,notes
{{CUSTOMER_NAME}},{{RENEWAL_DATE}},${{CURRENT_TCV}},{{RENEWAL_PROB}},{{GREEN/AMBER/RED}},"{short note on negotiation or exec interest}"

QBR Prep checklist (for CSMs) — timeline (2 weeks prior to QBR):
- 14 days: Confirm sponsor availability + collect stakeholder list.
- 10 days: Gather performance metrics + incidents summary.
- 7 days: Draft one-pager + circulate to AE/AM and Solutions Eng for technical sanity check.
- 3 days: Rehearse 7-minute run-through with Sponsor talking points.
- 0–1 day: Finalize customer-facing digest and confirm attachments.

Notes on tone & cadence:
- Leadership one-pager is internal and concise; use plain English, avoid product jargon.
- Customer-facing digest should be polished, appreciative, and action-oriented. Use bullet lists and clear asks.

Suggested escalation matrix (quick):
- Renewal Risk Score >= 8: CSM -> AM -> Head of Customer Success -> schedule E2E exec escalation within 3 business days.
- Technical outage impacting SLA: page SRE + notify Sponsor within 60 minutes.

Template change log:
- 2025-01-15: Initial draft by Aisha Kumar (CSM).
- 2025-02-03: Incorporated Solutions Eng feedback on mitigation language (Maya Patel).

Placeholders to replace before sending: {{CUSTOMER_NAME}}, {{SPONSOR_NAME}}, {{CSM_NAME}}, {{tokens_month}}, {{p95_ms}}, {{renewal_date}}, {{CURRENT_TCV}}, {{RENEWAL_PROB}}, {{date}}, {{owner}}, {{Q}}.

Free-form notes (scratch area for the CSM):
- POCs to propose: dedicated capacity pilot 3 months at X GPUs; billing structure suggestions; optional security review slot for legal.
- Potential exec intro: VP Engineering at AcmeCo has a prior relationship with Redwood's Head of Platform — consider warm intro if renewal risk increases.

End of template.
